Learning center

A better maintenance conversation

Prepare the information an owner and coordinator need.

Describe the issue

A useful report explains what happened, when it began, and the affected area. Add photos only when it is safe and use the designated reporting channel.

Set approvals before the problem

Owner expectations about costs, estimates, vendor access, and documentation should be discussed before repairs arise. Written expectations support consistent coordination.

Review recurring needs

Track repeated issues and upcoming replacements. Performance Plus includes preventative maintenance planning, which brings future property care into the management conversation.
